title: pywavfile parser-hardening fixture corpus
format: RIFF/WAVE binary fixtures generated by generate_fixtures.py
expectation_note: Some cases are marked *_or_* because the project must choose and document a policy (e.g. duplicate chunks, unusual but structurally valid ordering, partial frames).

bad_truncated_riff_header.wav.note: Physical file shorter than the 12-byte RIFF/WAVE header.

bad_invalid_riff_identifier.wav.note: Big-endian RIFX is outside supported scope; reject explicitly.

bad_invalid_form_identifier.wav.note: RIFF form type is not WAVE.

bad_riff_size_too_small.wav.note: RIFF declared size cannot contain the WAVE form type and chunks.

bad_riff_size_beyond_eof.wav.note: Declared RIFF boundary extends beyond physical EOF.

bad_riff_size_ends_inside_chunk.wav.note: RIFF boundary truncates the following chunk.

bad_truncated_chunk_header.wav.note: Chunk header is only four bytes.

bad_chunk_payload_beyond_riff.wav.note: Chunk declares payload beyond RIFF boundary.

bad_missing_chunk_padding.wav.note: Odd-sized chunk is missing its required pad byte.

bad_duplicate_fmt.wav.note: Duplicate fmt chunks; parser should reject or define deterministic policy.

bad_duplicate_data.wav.note: Duplicate data chunks; parser should reject or define deterministic policy.

bad_zero_bits_per_sample.wav.note: Bits per sample must be positive and supported.

bad_block_align_mismatch.wav.note: Block alignment inconsistent with channels and container width.

bad_byte_rate_mismatch.wav.note: Byte rate inconsistent with sample rate and block alignment.

bad_truncated_fmt_chunk.wav.note: fmt payload too short for required fields.

bad_compressed_format_tag.wav.note: A-law/compressed format is outside the intended PCM/float support.

bad_extensible_truncated_extension.wav.note: Extensible fmt chunk lacks complete extension.

bad_extensible_cbsize_too_small.wav.note: Extensible cbSize smaller than required 22 bytes.

bad_extensible_cbsize_exceeds_chunk.wav.note: cbSize claims more extension bytes than fmt chunk contains.

bad_extensible_valid_bits_zero.wav.note: Valid bits per sample should be positive.

bad_extensible_channel_mask_count.wav.note: Non-zero channel mask has one set bit but channel count is two.

bad_extensible_float_wrong_width.wav.note: IEEE float extensible format should use supported float container width.
